definition: Cold and dark means engines/APU stopped and electrical generation off. It does NOT mean every physically independent gauge is zero.

oh.fuel.temperature.details: Temperature is an actual environmental/fluid state, not always 0°C.

oh.elec.dc_amps.details: Meter may park at scale zero/offscale only when exact mechanism is established; missing live selection must not be treated as electrical zero

oh.elec.cps.details: Meter may park at scale zero/offscale only when exact mechanism is established; missing live selection must not be treated as electrical zero

oh.elec.dc_volts.details: Meter may park at scale zero/offscale only when exact mechanism is established; missing live selection must not be treated as electrical zero

oh.elec.ac_volts.details: Meter may park at scale zero/offscale only when exact mechanism is established; missing live selection must not be treated as electrical zero

oh.drive_oil.1.details: RISE is inlet-outlet temperature difference and can become zero; IN indicates actual inlet oil temperature. Unpowered pointer rest requires device reference

oh.drive_oil.2.details: RISE is inlet-outlet temperature difference and can become zero; IN indicates actual inlet oil temperature. Unpowered pointer rest requires device reference

oh.ac_amps.1.details: Meter may park at scale zero/offscale only when exact mechanism is established; missing live selection must not be treated as electrical zero

oh.ac_amps.2.details: Meter may park at scale zero/offscale only when exact mechanism is established; missing live selection must not be treated as electrical zero

oh.ac_amps.apu.details: Meter may park at scale zero/offscale only when exact mechanism is established; missing live selection must not be treated as electrical zero

oh.apu.egt.details: APU EGT after shutoff may remain hot and may not be indicated unpowered. No fabricated zero.

oh.cabin.diff_pressure_altitude.details: DIFF PRESS is 0 psi when equalized; CAB ALT follows ambient pressure altitude/field elevation, not necessarily 0

oh.cabin.rate.details: Zero rate if cabin pressure is steady; measure needle zero bearing from actual dial

oh.cabin.temperature.details: Temperature is an actual environmental/fluid state, not always 0°C.

oh.duct.pressure_lr.details: L/R duct pressures can hold transient pressure; do not force immediate zero after shutting down

capt.airspeed.details: Actual indicated speed is zero; photographed scale starts at 60 kt, so pointer parks at its low stop, not a nonexistent printed zero

capt.rmi.details: Needles can park or retain last bearing; compass card and bearing needles are NOT calibrated to zero heading.

capt.altimeter.details: On QNH aircraft at airport generally indicates airport elevation; do not force 0 ft.

capt.alt_ias_combined.details: Gauge identity/mechanism ambiguous in current source picture: must not manufacture start reading

capt.vertical_speed.details: VSI indicates zero climb/descent; dial zero position not universal twelve oclock

capt.clock.details: Clock remains actual time or stops at retained position; never zeros because aircraft is cold dark.

eng.left_upper_20_20.details: Gauge identity/mechanism ambiguous in current source picture: must not manufacture start reading

eng.fuel_qty.center.details: Fuel physically remains in tanks when electric buses are off; display may blank depending sensor power.

eng.fuel_qty.1.details: Fuel physically remains in tanks when electric buses are off; display may blank depending sensor power.

eng.fuel_qty.2.details: Fuel physically remains in tanks when electric buses are off; display may blank depending sensor power.

eng.n1.1.details: Spool speed 0 when stopped; analogue pointer position still requires native tick geometry

eng.n1.2.details: Spool speed 0 when stopped; analogue pointer position still requires native tick geometry

eng.egt.1.details: Exhaust temperature trends toward ambient after cool-down; unpowered electrical presentation may blank

eng.egt.2.details: Exhaust temperature trends toward ambient after cool-down; unpowered electrical presentation may blank

eng.n2.1.details: Spool speed 0 when stopped; analogue pointer position still requires native tick geometry

eng.n2.2.details: Spool speed 0 when stopped; analogue pointer position still requires native tick geometry

eng.fuel_flow.1.details: Fuel flow 0 when no fuel injected (fuel used totals retain their values)

eng.fuel_flow.2.details: Fuel flow 0 when no fuel injected (fuel used totals retain their values)

eng.oil_pressure.1.details: Oil pressure trends to zero after engine stop; transient residual pressure is not magically zero

eng.oil_pressure.2.details: Oil pressure trends to zero after engine stop; transient residual pressure is not magically zero

eng.oil_temperature.1.details: Oil temperature is retained and cools toward ambient, not always 0°C

eng.oil_temperature.2.details: Oil temperature is retained and cools toward ambient, not always 0°C

eng.hyd_pressure.a.details: Hydraulic pressures can retain residuals/accumulator pressure; use actual system model

eng.hyd_pressure.b.details: Hydraulic pressures can retain residuals/accumulator pressure; use actual system model

fo.flap_position.details: Flaps remain at their actual position; UP (0) only if left/right panels are physically up

fo.hyd_brake_pressure.details: Brake accumulator can retain pressure with AC/DC buses off

fo.airspeed.details: Actual indicated speed is zero; photographed scale starts at 60 kt, so pointer parks at its low stop, not a nonexistent printed zero

fo.rmi.details: Needles can park or retain last bearing; compass card and bearing needles are NOT calibrated to zero heading.

fo.left_linear.details: Two linear indicator windows not yet physically identified, no artificial zero

fo.right_linear.details: Two linear indicator windows not yet physically identified, no artificial zero

fo.outer_altimeter.details: On QNH aircraft at airport generally indicates airport elevation; do not force 0 ft.

fo.outer_vertical_speed.details: VSI indicates zero climb/descent; dial zero position not universal twelve oclock

fo.outer_clock.details: Clock remains actual time or stops at retained position; never zeros because aircraft is cold dark.

ped.stab_trim.left.details: Stabilizer trim holds actual surface position after power loss

ped.stab_trim.right.details: Stabilizer trim holds actual surface position after power loss

ped.rudder_trim.details: Rudder trim holds last actual trim angle

oh.crew_oxygen.pressure.details: Oxygen bottle has physical pressure with aircraft electrical power off. Never force zero unless empty.
